audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Leviticus / Vayiqra covenant blessing-and-warning text tradition, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for idols/Sabbath/sanctuary, agricultural blessing, peace, Divine dwelling, escalating covenant warnings, siege and exile trauma, land Sabbath, confession, covenant remembrance, and anti-abuse safeguards.

verses.restored: You shall not make idols for yourselves, nor raise carved image or pillar, nor put figured stone in your land to bow down upon it, for I am YHWH your Divine.

familiar.text: Ye shall make you no idols nor graven image, neither rear you up a standing image, neither shall ye set up any image of stone in your land, to bow down unto it: for I am the LORD your God.

modern.text: “You must not make idols for yourselves or set up a carved image or sacred pillar; you must not place a sculpted stone in your land to bow down to it. For I am the LORD your God.

original.text: לֹֽא תַעֲשׂ֨וּ לָכֶ֜ם אֱלִילִ֗ם וּפֶ֤סֶל וּמַצֵּבָה֙ לֹֽא תָקִ֣ימוּ לָכֶ֔ם וְאֶ֣בֶן מַשְׂכִּ֗ית לֹ֤א תִתְּנוּ֙ בְּאַרְצְכֶ֔ם לְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֖ת עָלֶ֑יהָ כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: My Sabbaths you shall keep, and my sanctuary you shall revere. I am YHWH.

familiar.text: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the LORD.

modern.text: You must keep My Sabbaths and have reverence for My sanctuary. I am the LORD.

original.text: אֶת שַׁבְּתֹתַ֣י תִּשְׁמֹ֔רוּ וּמִקְדָּשִׁ֖י תִּירָ֑אוּ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: If in my statutes you walk and my commands you keep and do them,

familiar.text: If ye walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;

modern.text: If you follow My statutes and carefully keep My commandments,

original.text: אִם בְּחֻקֹּתַ֖י תֵּלֵ֑כוּ וְאֶת מִצְוֺתַ֣י תִּשְׁמְר֔וּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָֽם

verses.restored: then I will give your rains in their season, land shall give its produce, and trees of field shall give their fruit.

familiar.text: Then I will give you rain in due season, and the land shall yield her increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.

modern.text: I will give you rains in their season, and the land will yield its produce, and the trees of the field will bear their fruit.

original.text: וְנָתַתִּ֥י גִשְׁמֵיכֶ֖ם בְּעִתָּ֑ם וְנָתְנָ֤ה הָאָ֨רֶץ֙ יְבוּלָ֔הּ וְעֵ֥ץ הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה יִתֵּ֥ן פִּרְיֽוֹ

verses.restored: Your threshing shall reach grape harvest, and grape harvest shall reach sowing; you shall eat your bread to satisfaction and dwell securely in your land.

familiar.text: And your threshing shall reach unto the vintage, and the vintage shall reach unto the sowing time: and ye shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.

modern.text: Your threshing will continue until the grape harvest, and the grape harvest will continue until sowing time; you will have your fill of food to eat and will dwell securely in your land.

original.text: וְהִשִּׂ֨יג לָכֶ֥ם דַּ֨יִשׁ֙ אֶת בָּצִ֔יר וּבָצִ֖יר יַשִּׂ֣יג אֶת זָ֑רַע וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֤ם לַחְמְכֶם֙ לָשֹׂ֔בַע וִֽישַׁבְתֶּ֥ם לָבֶ֖טַח בְּאַרְצְכֶֽם

verses.restored: I will give peace in land, and you shall lie down with none making you afraid. I will remove harmful beast from land, and sword shall not pass through your land.

familiar.text: And I will give peace in the land, and ye shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid: and I will rid evil beasts out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.

modern.text: And I will give peace to the land, and you will lie down with nothing to fear. I will rid the land of dangerous animals, and no sword will pass through your land.

original.text: וְנָתַתִּ֤י שָׁלוֹם֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ וּשְׁכַבְתֶּ֖ם וְאֵ֣ין מַחֲרִ֑יד וְהִשְׁבַּתִּ֞י חַיָּ֤ה רָעָה֙ מִן הָאָ֔רֶץ וְחֶ֖רֶב לֹא תַעֲבֹ֥ר בְּאַרְצְכֶֽם

verses.restored: You shall pursue your enemies, and they shall fall before you by sword.

familiar.text: And ye shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.

modern.text: You will pursue your enemies, and they will fall by the sword before you.

original.text: וּרְדַפְתֶּ֖ם אֶת אֹיְבֵיכֶ֑ם וְנָפְל֥וּ לִפְנֵיכֶ֖ם לֶחָֽרֶב

verses.restored: Five from you shall pursue a hundred, and a hundred from you shall pursue ten thousand; your enemies shall fall before you by sword.

familiar.text: And five of you shall chase an hundred, and an hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight: and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.

modern.text: Five of you will pursue a hundred, and a hundred of you will pursue ten thousand, and your enemies will fall by the sword before you.

original.text: וְרָדְפ֨וּ מִכֶּ֤ם חֲמִשָּׁה֙ מֵאָ֔ה וּמֵאָ֥ה מִכֶּ֖ם רְבָבָ֣ה יִרְדֹּ֑פוּ וְנָפְל֧וּ אֹיְבֵיכֶ֛ם לִפְנֵיכֶ֖ם לֶחָֽרֶב

verses.restored: I will turn toward you, make you fruitful, multiply you, and establish my covenant with you.

familiar.text: For I will have respect unto you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and establish my covenant with you.

modern.text: I will turn toward you and make you fruitful and multiply you, and I will establish My covenant with you.

original.text: וּפָנִ֣יתִי אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם וְהִפְרֵיתִ֣י אֶתְכֶ֔ם וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֖י אֶתְכֶ֑ם וַהֲקִימֹתִ֥י אֶת בְּרִיתִ֖י אִתְּכֶֽם

verses.restored: You shall eat old stored produce and bring out old because of new.

familiar.text: And ye shall eat old store, and bring forth the old because of the new.

modern.text: You will still be eating the old supply of grain when you need to clear it out to make room for the new.

original.text: וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֥ם יָשָׁ֖ן נוֹשָׁ֑ן וְיָשָׁ֕ן מִפְּנֵ֥י חָדָ֖שׁ תּוֹצִֽיאוּ

verses.restored: I will set my dwelling-place in your midst, and my soul/life shall not reject you.

familiar.text: And I will set my tabernacle among you: and my soul shall not abhor you.

modern.text: And I will make My dwelling place among you, and My soul will not despise you.

original.text: וְנָתַתִּ֥י מִשְׁכָּנִ֖י בְּתוֹכְכֶ֑ם וְלֹֽא תִגְעַ֥ל נַפְשִׁ֖י אֶתְכֶֽם

verses.restored: I will walk in your midst and be your Divine, and you shall be my people.

familiar.text: And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be my people.

modern.text: I will walk among you and be your God, and you will be My people.

original.text: וְהִתְהַלַּכְתִּי֙ בְּת֣וֹכְכֶ֔ם וְהָיִ֥יתִי לָכֶ֖ם לֵֽאלֹהִ֑ים וְאַתֶּ֖ם תִּהְיוּ לִ֥י לְעָֽם

verses.restored: I am YHWH your Divine, who brought you out from land of Egypt, from being their slaves; I broke bars of your yoke and made you walk upright.

familiar.text: I am the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, that ye should not be their bondmen; and I have broken the bands of your yoke, and made you go upright.

modern.text: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt so that you would no longer be slaves to the Egyptians. I broke the bars of your yoke and enabled you to walk in uprightness. Punishments for Disobedience (Leviticus 20:1–9; Deuteronomy 28:15–68)

original.text: אֲנִ֞י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצֵ֤אתִי אֶתְכֶם֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם מִֽהְיֹ֥ת לָהֶ֖ם עֲבָדִ֑ים וָאֶשְׁבֹּר֙ מֹטֹ֣ת עֻלְּכֶ֔ם וָאוֹלֵ֥ךְ אֶתְכֶ֖ם קֽוֹמְמִיּֽוּת

verses.restored: But if you do not listen to me and do not do all these commands,

familiar.text: But if ye will not hearken unto me, and will not do all these commandments;

modern.text: If, however, you fail to obey Me and to carry out all these commandments,

original.text: וְאִם לֹ֥א תִשְׁמְע֖וּ לִ֑י וְלֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ אֵ֥ת כָּל הַמִּצְוֺ֖ת הָאֵֽלֶּה

verses.restored: and if you reject my statutes, and if your soul/life loathes my judgments so you do not do all my commands, breaking my covenant,

familiar.text: And if ye shall despise my statutes, or if your soul abhor my judgments, so that ye will not do all my commandments, but that ye break my covenant:

modern.text: and if you reject My statutes, despise My ordinances, and neglect to carry out all My commandments, and so break My covenant,

original.text: וְאִם בְּחֻקֹּתַ֣י תִּמְאָ֔סוּ וְאִ֥ם אֶת מִשְׁפָּטַ֖י תִּגְעַ֣ל נַפְשְׁכֶ֑ם לְבִלְתִּ֤י עֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת כָּל מִצְוֺתַ֔י לְהַפְרְכֶ֖ם אֶת בְּרִיתִֽי

verses.restored: then I too will do this to you: appoint over you terror, wasting disease, and fever consuming eyes and causing soul/life to languish; you shall sow your seed for nothing, and your enemies shall eat it.

familiar.text: I also will do this unto you; I will even appoint over you terror, consumption, and the burning ague, that shall consume the eyes, and cause sorrow of heart: and ye shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.

modern.text: then this is what I will do to you: I will bring upon you sudden terror, wasting disease, and fever that will destroy your sight and drain your life. You will sow your seed in vain, because your enemies will eat it.

original.text: אַף אֲנִ֞י אֶֽעֱשֶׂה זֹּ֣את לָכֶ֗ם וְהִפְקַדְתִּ֨י עֲלֵיכֶ֤ם בֶּֽהָלָה֙ אֶת הַשַּׁחֶ֣פֶת וְאֶת הַקַּדַּ֔חַת מְכַלּ֥וֹת עֵינַ֖יִם וּמְדִיבֹ֣ת נָ֑פֶשׁ וּזְרַעְתֶּ֤ם לָרִיק֙ זַרְעֲכֶ֔ם וַאֲכָלֻ֖הוּ אֹיְבֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: I will set my face against you, and you shall be struck before your enemies; those hating you shall rule over you, and you shall flee when none pursues.

familiar.text: And I will set my face against you, and ye shall be slain before your enemies: they that hate you shall reign over you; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you.

modern.text: And I will set My face against you, so that you will be defeated by your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you, and you will flee when no one pursues you.

original.text: וְנָתַתִּ֤י פָנַי֙ בָּכֶ֔ם וְנִגַּפְתֶּ֖ם לִפְנֵ֣י אֹיְבֵיכֶ֑ם וְרָד֤וּ בָכֶם֙ שֹֽׂנְאֵיכֶ֔ם וְנַסְתֶּ֖ם וְאֵין רֹדֵ֥ף אֶתְכֶֽם

verses.restored: If after these you do not listen to me, I will add to discipline you sevenfold for your sins/misalignments.

familiar.text: And if ye will not yet for all this hearken unto me, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins.

modern.text: And if after all this you will not obey Me, I will proceed to punish you sevenfold for your sins.

original.text: וְאִ֨ם עַד אֵ֔לֶּה לֹ֥א תִשְׁמְע֖וּ לִ֑י וְיָסַפְתִּי֙ לְיַסְּרָ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם שֶׁ֖בַע עַל חַטֹּאתֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: I will break pride of your strength and make your heavens like iron and your earth like bronze.

familiar.text: And I will break the pride of your power; and I will make your heaven as iron, and your earth as brass:

modern.text: I will break down your stubborn pride and make your sky like iron and your land like bronze,

original.text: וְשָׁבַרְתִּ֖י אֶת גְּא֣וֹן עֻזְּכֶ֑ם וְנָתַתִּ֤י אֶת שְׁמֵיכֶם֙ כַּבַּרְזֶ֔ל וְאֶֽת אַרְצְכֶ֖ם כַּנְּחֻשָֽׁה

verses.restored: Your strength shall be spent for nothing; your land shall not give its produce and trees of land shall not give their fruit.

familiar.text: And your strength shall be spent in vain: for your land shall not yield her increase, neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruits.

modern.text: and your strength will be spent in vain. For your land will not yield its produce, and the trees of the land will not bear their fruit.

original.text: וְתַ֥ם לָרִ֖יק כֹּחֲכֶ֑ם וְלֹֽא תִתֵּ֤ן אַרְצְכֶם֙ אֶת יְבוּלָ֔הּ וְעֵ֣ץ הָאָ֔רֶץ לֹ֥א יִתֵּ֖ן פִּרְיֽוֹ

verses.restored: If you walk contrary to me and are unwilling to listen to me, I will add plague upon you sevenfold according to your sins/misalignments.

familiar.text: And if ye walk contrary unto me, and will not hearken unto me; I will bring seven times more plagues upon you according to your sins.

modern.text: If you walk in hostility toward Me and refuse to obey Me, I will multiply your plagues seven times, according to your sins.

original.text: וְאִם תֵּֽלְכ֤וּ עִמִּי֙ קֶ֔רִי וְלֹ֥א תֹאב֖וּ לִשְׁמֹ֣עַֽ לִ֑י וְיָסַפְתִּ֤י עֲלֵיכֶם֙ מַכָּ֔ה שֶׁ֖בַע כְּחַטֹּאתֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: I will send beast of field among you; it shall bereave you, cut off your livestock, diminish you, and your roads shall become desolate.

familiar.text: I will also send wild beasts among you, which shall rob you of your children, and destroy your cattle, and make you few in number; and your high ways shall be desolate.

modern.text: I will send wild animals against you to rob you of your children, destroy your livestock, and reduce your numbers, until your roads lie desolate.

original.text: וְהִשְׁלַחְתִּ֨י בָכֶ֜ם אֶת חַיַּ֤ת הַשָּׂדֶה֙ וְשִׁכְּלָ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם וְהִכְרִ֨יתָה֙ אֶת בְּהֶמְתְּכֶ֔ם וְהִמְעִ֖יטָה אֶתְכֶ֑ם וְנָשַׁ֖מּוּ דַּרְכֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: If by these you are not corrected toward me but walk contrary to me,

familiar.text: And if ye will not be reformed by me by these things, but will walk contrary unto me;

modern.text: And if in spite of these things you do not accept My discipline, but continue to walk in hostility toward Me,

original.text: וְאִ֨ם בְּאֵ֔לֶּה לֹ֥א תִוָּסְר֖וּ לִ֑י וַהֲלַכְתֶּ֥ם עִמִּ֖י קֶֽרִי

verses.restored: then I too will walk contrary to you and strike you, I also, sevenfold for your sins/misalignments.

familiar.text: Then will I also walk contrary unto you, and will punish you yet seven times for your sins.

modern.text: then I will act with hostility toward you, and I will strike you sevenfold for your sins.

original.text: וְהָלַכְתִּ֧י אַף אֲנִ֛י עִמָּכֶ֖ם בְּקֶ֑רִי וְהִכֵּיתִ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ גַּם אָ֔נִי שֶׁ֖בַע עַל חַטֹּאתֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: I will bring upon you sword avenging covenant; you shall gather into your cities, and I will send pestilence in your midst, and you shall be given into hand of enemy.

familiar.text: And I will bring a sword upon you, that shall avenge the quarrel of my covenant: and when ye are gathered together within your cities, I will send the pestilence among you; and ye shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.

modern.text: And I will bring a sword against you to execute the vengeance of the covenant. Though you withdraw into your cities, I will send a plague among you, and you will be delivered into the hand of the enemy.

original.text: וְהֵבֵאתִ֨י עֲלֵיכֶ֜ם חֶ֗רֶב נֹקֶ֨מֶת֙ נְקַם בְּרִ֔ית וְנֶאֱסַפְתֶּ֖ם אֶל עָרֵיכֶ֑ם וְשִׁלַּ֤חְתִּי דֶ֨בֶר֙ בְּת֣וֹכְכֶ֔ם וְנִתַּתֶּ֖ם בְּיַד אוֹיֵֽב

verses.restored: When I break staff of bread for you, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven and return your bread by weight; you shall eat and not be satisfied.

familiar.text: And when I have broken the staff of your bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver you your bread again by weight: and ye shall eat, and not be satisfied.

modern.text: When I cut off your supply of bread, ten women will bake your bread in a single oven and dole out your bread by weight, so that you will eat but not be satisfied.

original.text: בְּשִׁבְרִ֣י לָכֶם֮ מַטֵּה לֶחֶם֒ וְ֠אָפוּ עֶ֣שֶׂר נָשִׁ֤ים לַחְמְכֶם֙ בְּתַנּ֣וּר אֶחָ֔ד וְהֵשִׁ֥יבוּ לַחְמְכֶ֖ם בַּמִּשְׁקָ֑ל וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֖ם וְלֹ֥א תִשְׂבָּֽעוּ

verses.restored: If by this you do not listen to me but walk contrary to me,

familiar.text: And if ye will not for all this hearken unto me, but walk contrary unto me;

modern.text: But if in spite of all this you do not obey Me, but continue to walk in hostility toward Me,

original.text: וְאִ֨ם בְּזֹ֔את לֹ֥א תִשְׁמְע֖וּ לִ֑י וַהֲלַכְתֶּ֥ם עִמִּ֖י בְּקֶֽרִי

verses.restored: then I will walk contrary to you in fury, and I also will discipline you sevenfold for your sins/misalignments.

familiar.text: Then I will walk contrary unto you also in fury; and I, even I, will chastise you seven times for your sins.

modern.text: then I will walk in fury against you, and I, even I, will punish you sevenfold for your sins.

original.text: וְהָלַכְתִּ֥י עִמָּכֶ֖ם בַּחֲמַת קֶ֑רִי וְיִסַּרְתִּ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ אַף אָ֔נִי שֶׁ֖בַע עַל חַטֹּאתֵיכֶם

verses.restored: You shall eat flesh of your sons, and flesh of your daughters you shall eat.

familiar.text: And ye shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters shall ye eat.

modern.text: You will eat the flesh of your own sons and daughters.

original.text: וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֖ם בְּשַׂ֣ר בְּנֵיכֶ֑ם וּבְשַׂ֥ר בְּנֹתֵיכֶ֖ם תֹּאכֵֽלוּ

verses.restored: I will destroy your high places, cut down your incense altars, put your corpses upon corpses of your idols, and my soul/life shall reject you.

familiar.text: And I will destroy your high places, and cut down your images, and cast your carcases upon the carcases of your idols, and my soul shall abhor you.

modern.text: I will destroy your high places, cut down your incense altars, and heap your lifeless bodies on the lifeless remains of your idols; and My soul will despise you.

original.text: וְהִשְׁמַדְתִּ֞י אֶת בָּמֹֽתֵיכֶ֗ם וְהִכְרַתִּי֙ אֶת חַמָּ֣נֵיכֶ֔ם וְנָֽתַתִּי֙ אֶת פִּגְרֵיכֶ֔ם עַל פִּגְרֵ֖י גִּלּוּלֵיכֶ֑ם וְגָעֲלָ֥ה נַפְשִׁ֖י אֶתְכֶֽם

verses.restored: I will make your cities a ruin and desolate your sanctuaries, and I will not smell your soothing scents.

familiar.text: And I will make your cities waste, and bring your sanctuaries unto desolation, and I will not smell the savour of your sweet odours.

modern.text: I will reduce your cities to rubble and lay waste your sanctuaries, and I will refuse to smell the pleasing aroma of your sacrifices.

original.text: וְנָתַתִּ֤י אֶת עָֽרֵיכֶם֙ חָרְבָּ֔ה וַהֲשִׁמּוֹתִ֖י אֶת מִקְדְּשֵׁיכֶ֑ם וְלֹ֣א אָרִ֔יחַ בְּרֵ֖יחַ נִיחֹֽחֲכֶֽם

verses.restored: I myself will desolate land, and your enemies who dwell in it shall be appalled at it.

familiar.text: And I will bring the land into desolation: and your enemies which dwell therein shall be astonished at it.

modern.text: And I will lay waste the land, so that your enemies who dwell in it will be appalled.

original.text: וַהֲשִׁמֹּתִ֥י אֲנִ֖י אֶת הָאָ֑רֶץ וְשָֽׁמְמ֤וּ עָלֶ֨יהָ֙ אֹֽיְבֵיכֶ֔ם הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בָּֽהּ

verses.restored: You I will scatter among nations, and I will unsheathe sword after you; your land shall be desolation and your cities ruin.

familiar.text: And I will scatter you among the heathen, and will draw out a sword after you: and your land shall be desolate, and your cities waste.

modern.text: But I will scatter you among the nations and will draw out a sword after you as your land becomes desolate and your cities are laid waste.

original.text: וְאֶתְכֶם֙ אֱזָרֶ֣ה בַגּוֹיִ֔ם וַהֲרִיקֹתִ֥י אַחֲרֵיכֶ֖ם חָ֑רֶב וְהָיְתָ֤ה אַרְצְכֶם֙ שְׁמָמָ֔ה וְעָרֵיכֶ֖ם יִהְי֥וּ חָרְבָּֽה

verses.restored: Then land shall enjoy its Sabbaths all days of its desolation, while you are in land of your enemies; then land shall rest and enjoy its Sabbaths.

familiar.text: Then shall the land enjoy her sabbaths, as long as it lieth desolate, and ye be in your enemies’ land; even then shall the land rest, and enjoy her sabbaths.

modern.text: Then the land shall enjoy its Sabbaths all the days it lies desolate, while you are in the land of your enemies. At that time the land will rest and enjoy its Sabbaths.

original.text: אָז֩ תִּרְצֶ֨ה הָאָ֜רֶץ אֶת שַׁבְּתֹתֶ֗יהָ כֹּ֚ל יְמֵ֣י הֳשַׁמָּ֔ה וְאַתֶּ֖ם בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֹיְבֵיכֶ֑ם אָ֚ז תִּשְׁבַּ֣ת הָאָ֔רֶץ וְהִרְצָ֖ת אֶת שַׁבְּתֹתֶֽיהָ

verses.restored: All days of its desolation it shall rest, what it did not rest in your Sabbaths when you dwelt upon it.

familiar.text: As long as it lieth desolate it shall rest; because it did not rest in your sabbaths, when ye dwelt upon it.

modern.text: As long as it lies desolate, the land will have the rest it did not receive during the Sabbaths when you lived in it.

original.text: כָּל יְמֵ֥י הָשַּׁמָּ֖ה תִּשְׁבֹּ֑ת אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא שָׁבְתָ֛ה בְּשַׁבְּתֹתֵיכֶ֖ם בְּשִׁבְתְּכֶ֥ם עָלֶֽיהָ

verses.restored: As for those remaining among you, I will bring faintness into their hearts in lands of their enemies; sound of driven leaf shall pursue them, and they shall flee as from sword and fall when none pursues.

familiar.text: And upon them that are left alive of you I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies; and the sound of a shaken leaf shall chase them; and they shall flee, as fleeing from a sword; and they shall fall when none pursueth.

modern.text: As for those of you who survive, I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies, so that even the sound of a windblown leaf will put them to flight. And they will flee as one flees the sword, and fall when no one pursues them.

original.text: וְהַנִּשְׁאָרִ֣ים בָּכֶ֔ם וְהֵבֵ֤אתִי מֹ֨רֶךְ֙ בִּלְבָבָ֔ם בְּאַרְצֹ֖ת אֹיְבֵיהֶ֑ם וְרָדַ֣ף אֹתָ֗ם ק֚וֹל עָלֶ֣ה נִדָּ֔ף וְנָס֧וּ מְנֻֽסַת חֶ֛רֶב וְנָפְל֖וּ וְאֵ֥ין רֹדֵֽף

verses.restored: They shall stumble one over another as before sword, though no pursuer; and there shall be no standing for you before your enemies.

familiar.text: And they shall fall one upon another, as it were before a sword, when none pursueth: and ye shall have no power to stand before your enemies.

modern.text: They will stumble over one another as before the sword, though no one is behind them. So you will not be able to stand against your enemies.

original.text: וְכָשְׁל֧וּ אִישׁ בְּאָחִ֛יו כְּמִפְּנֵי חֶ֖רֶב וְרֹדֵ֣ף אָ֑יִן וְלֹא תִֽהְיֶ֤ה לָכֶם֙ תְּקוּמָ֔ה לִפְנֵ֖י אֹֽיְבֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: You shall perish among nations, and land of your enemies shall consume you.

familiar.text: And ye shall perish among the heathen, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.

modern.text: You will perish among the nations, and the land of your enemies will consume you.

original.text: וַאֲבַדְתֶּ֖ם בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם וְאָכְלָ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם אֶ֖רֶץ אֹיְבֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: Those remaining among you shall waste away in their iniquity in lands of your enemies; and also in iniquities of their ancestors with them they shall waste away.

familiar.text: And they that are left of you shall pine away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers shall they pine away with them.

modern.text: Those of you who survive in the lands of your enemies will waste away in their iniquity and will decay in the sins of their fathers. God Remembers Those Who Repent

original.text: וְהַנִּשְׁאָרִ֣ים בָּכֶ֗ם יִמַּ֨קּוּ֙ בַּֽעֲוֺנָ֔ם בְּאַרְצֹ֖ת אֹיְבֵיכֶ֑ם וְאַ֛ף בַּעֲוֺנֹ֥ת אֲבֹתָ֖ם אִתָּ֥ם יִמָּֽקּוּ

verses.restored: Then they shall confess their iniquity and iniquity of their ancestors, in their unfaithfulness that they acted unfaithfully against me, and also that they walked contrary to me.

familiar.text: If they shall confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, with their trespass which they trespassed against me, and that also they have walked contrary unto me;

modern.text: But if they will confess their iniquity and that of their fathers in the unfaithfulness that they practiced against Me, by which they have also walked in hostility toward Me—

original.text: וְהִתְוַדּ֤וּ אֶת עֲוֺנָם֙ וְאֶת עֲוֺ֣ן אֲבֹתָ֔ם בְּמַעֲלָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָֽעֲלוּ בִ֑י וְאַ֕ף אֲשֶׁר הָֽלְכ֥וּ עִמִּ֖י בְּקֶֽרִי

verses.restored: I too walked contrary to them and brought them into land of their enemies; then their uncircumcised heart shall be humbled, and then they shall accept their iniquity.

familiar.text: And that I also have walked contrary unto them, and have brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised hearts be humbled, and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity:

modern.text: and I acted with hostility toward them and brought them into the land of their enemies—and if their uncircumcised hearts will be humbled and they will make amends for their iniquity,

original.text: אַף אֲנִ֗י אֵלֵ֤ךְ עִמָּם֙ בְּקֶ֔רִי וְהֵבֵאתִ֣י אֹתָ֔ם בְּאֶ֖רֶץ אֹיְבֵיהֶ֑ם אוֹ אָ֣ז יִכָּנַ֗ע לְבָבָם֙ הֶֽעָרֵ֔ל וְאָ֖ז יִרְצ֥וּ אֶת עֲוֺנָֽם

verses.restored: Then I will remember my covenant with Jacob, and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham I will remember, and land I will remember.

familiar.text: Then will I remember my covenant with Jacob, and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember; and I will remember the land.

modern.text: then I will remember My covenant with Jacob and My covenant with Isaac and My covenant with Abraham, and I will remember the land.

original.text: וְזָכַרְתִּ֖י אֶת בְּרִיתִ֣י יַעֲק֑וֹב וְאַף֩ אֶת בְּרִיתִ֨י יִצְחָ֜ק וְאַ֨ף אֶת בְּרִיתִ֧י אַבְרָהָ֛ם אֶזְכֹּ֖ר וְהָאָ֥רֶץ אֶזְכֹּֽר

verses.restored: The land shall be forsaken by them and shall enjoy its Sabbaths while desolate without them; and they shall accept their iniquity because they rejected my judgments and their soul/life loathed my statutes.

familiar.text: The land also shall be left of them, and shall enjoy her sabbaths, while she lieth desolate without them: and they shall accept of the punishment of their iniquity: because, even because they despised my judgments, and because their soul abhorred my statutes.

modern.text: For the land will be abandoned by them, and it will enjoy its Sabbaths by lying desolate without them. And they will pay the penalty for their iniquity, because they rejected My ordinances and abhorred My statutes.

original.text: וְהָאָרֶץ֩ תֵּעָזֵ֨ב מֵהֶ֜ם וְתִ֣רֶץ אֶת שַׁבְּתֹתֶ֗יהָ בָּהְשַׁמָּה֙ מֵהֶ֔ם וְהֵ֖ם יִרְצ֣וּ אֶת עֲוֺנָ֑ם יַ֣עַן וּבְיַ֔עַן בְּמִשְׁפָּטַ֣י מָאָ֔סוּ וְאֶת חֻקֹּתַ֖י גָּעֲלָ֥ה נַפְשָֽׁם

verses.restored: Yet even so, when they are in land of their enemies, I will not reject them and will not loathe them to destroy them completely, to break my covenant with them; for I am YHWH their Divine.

familiar.text: And yet for all that, when they be in the land of their enemies, I will not cast them away, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them: for I am the LORD their God.

modern.text: Yet in spite of this, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject or despise them so as to destroy them and break My covenant with them; for I am the LORD their God.

original.text: וְאַף גַּם זֹ֠את בִּֽהְיוֹתָ֞ם בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֹֽיְבֵיהֶ֗ם לֹֽא מְאַסְתִּ֤ים וְלֹֽא גְעַלְתִּים֙ לְכַלֹּתָ֔ם לְהָפֵ֥ר בְּרִיתִ֖י אִתָּ֑ם כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: I will remember for them covenant of ancestors whom I brought out from land of Egypt before eyes of nations, to be their Divine. I am YHWH.

familiar.text: But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the heathen, that I might be their God: I am the LORD.

modern.text: But for their sake I will remember the covenant with their fathers, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, that I might be their God. I am the LORD.”

original.text: וְזָכַרְתִּ֥י לָהֶ֖ם בְּרִ֣ית רִאשֹׁנִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר הוֹצֵֽאתִי אֹתָם֩ מֵאֶ֨רֶץ מִצְרַ֜יִם לְעֵינֵ֣י הַגּוֹיִ֗ם לִהְיֹ֥ת לָהֶ֛ם לֵאלֹהִ֖ים אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: These are statutes, judgments, and Torah/instructions that YHWH set between himself and children of Israel on Mount Sinai by hand of Moses.

familiar.text: These are the statutes and judgments and laws, which the LORD made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by the hand of Moses.

modern.text: These are the statutes, ordinances, and laws that the LORD established between Himself and the Israelites through Moses on Mount Sinai.

original.text: אֵ֠לֶּה הַֽחֻקִּ֣ים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים֮ וְהַתּוֹרֹת֒ אֲשֶׁר֙ נָתַ֣ן יְהוָ֔ה בֵּינ֕וֹ וּבֵ֖ין בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּהַ֥ר סִינַ֖י בְּיַד מֹשֶֽׁה

translation_notes: Blessing culminates not merely in prosperity but in Divine dwelling, walking among the people, and liberation-shaped uprightness.
The warning section uses escalating covenant-curse rhetoric common to ancient treaty forms; it should not be individualized into simplistic blame for every illness, disaster, or trauma.
Siege cannibalism imagery reflects catastrophic warfare and must be handled as trauma text, not threat theater.
Land Sabbath becomes a theological witness during exile: exploited land receives the rest denied to it.
The chapter does not end in abandonment. Verses 44-45 explicitly deny total rejection and reaffirm covenant remembrance in exile.
safety_note: Do not use Leviticus 26 to tell abused, ill, disabled, poor, traumatized, colonized, or disaster-stricken people that their suffering proves Divine punishment. Preserve this as ancient communal covenant-warning rhetoric while centering confession, land rest, non-abandonment, and remembered liberation.
